data.name: Reemal
data.gender_notes: Reemal is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word for gazelle, a graceful and elegant animal often used as a symbol of beauty and agility in Islamic culture. The name Reemal carries the meaning “Gazelle” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Reemal usually hope their child will grow to embody gazelle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the grace, agility, and beauty of nature and the divine.
data.etymology: Reemal belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gazelle.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Reemal total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: ريمـال
in_arabic.meaning: ريمـال تعني الرمال الناعمة أو رمل البحر
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ريمـال مشتق من كلمة رمل، و تعني الرمال الناعمة أو رمل البحر. و يستخدم هذا الاسم في بعض الثقافات العربية للإشارة إلى الجمال و النعومة. كما يمكن أن يرتبط بالطبيعة و البيئة الصحراوية في بعض الأحيان.

in_urdu.name: ریمال
in_urdu.meaning: ریمال کا مطلب ہے نرم ریت یا سمندر کا ریت
in_urdu.long_meaning: ریمال نام عربی زبان کے الفاظ سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے نرم ریت یا سمندر کی ریت۔ یہ نام بعض اوقات مشرقی ثقافتوں میں خوبصورتی اور نرمی کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ، یہ نام صحرائی ماحول اور فطرت سے بھی منسلک ہو سکتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: रीमल
in_hindi.meaning: रीमल का अर्थ है मुलायम रेत या समुद्र की रेत
in_hindi.long_meaning: रीमल नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है मुलायम रेत या समुद्र की रेत। यह नाम कुछ संस्कृतियों में सौंदर्य और कोमलता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। इसके अतिरिक्त, यह नाम मरुस्थलीय वातावरण और प्रकृति से भी जुड़ा हो सकता है।

in_pashto.name: ریمال
in_pashto.meaning: ریمال د نرم شګه یا د سمندر شګه معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: د ریمال نوم د عربی کلمو څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د نرم شګې یا د سمندر د شګې معنی لري. دا نوم په ځینو کلتورونو کې د ښکلا او نرمي لپاره کارول کیږي. سربیره پردې، دا نوم کولی شي د صحرايي چاپیریال او فطرت سره هم تړاو ولري.

in_english.name: Reemal
in_english.meaning: Reemal means soft sand or sand of the sea
in_english.long_meaning: The name Reemal is derived from Arabic roots, specifically from the word 'raml', which means sand. It can be interpreted as soft sand or the sand of the sea. This name is used in various cultures to signify beauty, gentleness, and smoothness. It may also be associated with desert environments and natural landscapes. The etymology of Reemal is linked to the Arabic language, where 'raml' (رمل) is a common term for sand, often used in Quranic contexts to describe desert terrains and sandy dunes.

data.cultural_impact: Reemal, as a name inspired by the gazelle, carries with it the elegance, grace, and beauty that this animal represents in Islamic tradition. In various Arab literary and artistic works, the gazelle is used as a poetic symbol of fitness, strength, and agility, reflecting the admiration of such qualities. For a person named Reemal, this can translate into the expectation and encouragement of her to embody the grace and agility that the name evokes.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic spirituality, the gazelle is also a symbol of the believer who seeks closeness to God. The Prophet Muhammad is reported to have said, "A good deed done in secret brings its reward with the Most Exalted; but an evil deed hears its descrainer in the Hellfire" (Bukhari, 11:63). Like the gazelle moving quietly and nimbly through its environment, a person living a pious and secretive life, driven by sincere intentions, can be said to be embodying this meaning of the name.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Reemal: Soft and gentle, symbolizing the nurturing and compassionate nature of Allah (swt) towards His creation. It is a reminder to embody these qualities in our daily lives.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Al-Masudi, 'Muruj Al-Dhahab wa Ma'adin Al-Jawhar', Volume II, p. 139, mentions a city called Reemal in Yemen that was an important caravan trade center during the Ayyubid period (1171-1250 AD).

Ibn Battuta, 'Rihla', Volume I, p. 124, describes visiting a city called Reemah (Reemal) in Yemen during the 14th century AD. He mentions that it was a major center for the production of frankincense and myrrh.
historical_references.context: Major center for the production of frankincense and myrrh
